entries.answer: Yes, we build a smart menu for a restaurant. A customer scans a QR code printed on the menu and is directed to the menu page to order, the order goes to the restaurant, and there is an admin side to view sales. It is a Web App (menu page, ordering, admin dashboard) plus UI/UX Design, with the CRM & Insights Agent as an add-on for AI forecasting, popular dishes, most likely to sell, and least likely to sell. Rough estimate: $2,600 to $7,700. It does not match a package, so there is no bundle saving. The final price is a custom quote after scope. Rough estimate, not a quote. The final price depends on scope, and we confirm it before any work starts.
entries.title: Smart menu with QR ordering for a restaurant
